description: Phase C hard-relational candidates. Authored cross-ref-grounded multi-hop queries; surface terms point at one procedure, the normative answer lives in a different (dependency) clause. Gated by dev-relational-eval-gate.mjs; only hybrid-misses (target outside top-10) merge into eval-queries.json.

queries.query: After timeAlignmentTimer expires the UE keeps transmitting on PUSCH using its existing uplink grant instead of treating the uplink as out of synchronisation.
queries.rationale: Surface terms PUSCH/uplink-grant point at UL grant reception (38.321#5.4.1); the normative 'flush HARQ, clear grants, consider UL out-of-sync' rule lives in TA maintenance.

queries.query: Beam failure is detected on the SpCell but the UE never starts the random access procedure for beam failure recovery.
queries.rationale: Beam-failure detection counters/thresholds are PHY (38.213#6 link recovery); the RA-for-BFR trigger is MAC (38.321#5.17).

queries.query: When the sCellDeactivationTimer expires the UE continues to send CSI reports and SRS on the deactivated secondary cell.
queries.rationale: Surface CSI/SRS point at PHY reporting; the deactivation-stops-CSI/SRS/PDCCH rule is in MAC SCell activation/deactivation.

queries.query: On RRC reconfiguration with sync the PDCP entity is re-established but the corresponding RLC entity keeps its old state variables and buffered PDUs.
queries.rationale: Surface PDCP re-establishment (38.323#5.1.2); the answer about RLC discarding state on re-establishment is in 38.322#5.1.2.

queries.query: Measurement event A3 entry condition is met and the report is sent, but the UE never applies the handover command to the target cell.
queries.rationale: Surface event-A3/measurement-report (38.331#5.5.4); the handover-execution behaviour is reconfiguration-with-sync (38.331#5.3.5.1).

queries.query: RRCResume fails because the UE cannot comply with the received configuration, yet the UE does not fall back to establishing a new RRC connection.
queries.rationale: Surface RRCResume reception (38.331#5.3.13.4); the failure-handling/fallback rule is 38.331#5.3.13.5.

queries.query: The drx-onDurationTimer is running so the UE is in DRX Active Time, yet it does not monitor PDCCH on the configured search spaces.
queries.rationale: Surface PDCCH/search-space (38.213#10); the Active-Time-implies-monitor-PDCCH definition is DRX (38.321#5.7).

queries.query: A DCI indicates PDCCH monitoring skipping for a duration that overlaps the DRX onDuration, and the UE stops monitoring PDCCH for the whole onDuration.
queries.rationale: Surface DRX/onDuration (38.321#5.7); the skipping-vs-monitoring interaction is in PDCCH skipping (38.213#10.4).

queries.query: A scheduling request is triggered for SCell beam failure recovery but no SR PUCCH resource is available, and the UE never initiates a random access procedure as the fallback for the recovery.
queries.rationale: Surface scheduling-request/PUCCH points at SR transmission (38.321#5.4.4); the BFR-falls-back-to-RA-when-no-SR-resource rule lives in beam failure recovery (38.321#5.17).

queries.query: The UE decodes a DCI scrambled with the RA-RNTI inside the RAR window but never stops ra-ResponseWindow or processes the contained backoff and uplink grant.
queries.rationale: Surface RA-RNTI/RAR-window/DCI points at the PHY RAR detection procedure (38.213#8.2); the MAC handling of ra-ResponseWindow, backoff and RAR contents is Random Access Response reception (38.321#5.1.4).

queries.query: The ra-ContentionResolutionTimer expires without a successful contention resolution, but the UE does not go back to pick a new random access preamble and resource.
queries.rationale: Surface ra-ContentionResolutionTimer points at Contention Resolution (38.321#5.1.5); the answer that an unsuccessful attempt re-runs preamble/resource selection lives in Random Access Resource selection (38.321#5.1.2).

queries.query: On the AM RLC receiving side t-Reassembly expires and a STATUS report is triggered, but the transmitting side never retransmits the RLC SDU segments that were reported as missing.
queries.rationale: Surface t-Reassembly/STATUS points at the receiver's reassembly-timer handling (38.322#5.2.3.2.4); the normative retransmission-on-NACK behaviour is on the AM transmitting side (38.322#5.3.2).

queries.query: Upper layers request PDCP data recovery on an AM bearer, yet the lower-layer RLC entity is never re-established so the retransmitted PDUs are duplicated on air.
queries.rationale: Surface PDCP-data-recovery points at PDCP data recovery (38.323#5.5); the dependency that RLC must be re-established (discard PDUs/reset state) lives in RLC entity re-establishment (38.322#5.1.2).

queries.query: The PDCP discardTimer expires for an SDU already handed to RLC, but the RLC entity still transmits it and even leaves a sequence-number gap behind.
queries.rationale: Surface discardTimer points at PDCP SDU discard (38.323#5.3); the rule that RLC discards the indicated SDU only if not yet submitted and must not introduce an SN gap is in RLC SDU discard procedures (38.322#5.4).

queries.query: T310 expires in the PCell and radio link failure is declared, but the UE never sets the contents of the RRCReestablishmentRequest before sending it after cell selection.
queries.rationale: Surface T310/radio-link-failure points at RLF detection (38.331#5.3.10.3); the answer about populating and transmitting RRCReestablishmentRequest is in 38.331#5.3.7.4.

queries.query: T304 expires during a reconfiguration with sync so handover fails, but the UE does not initiate re-establishment by selecting a suitable cell and sending the reestablishment request.
queries.rationale: Surface T304/reconfiguration-with-sync-failure points at the T304-expiry clause (38.331#5.3.5.8.3); the actual reestablishment-request transmission behaviour is in 38.331#5.3.7.4.

queries.query: A conditional handover candidate's execution condition is satisfied during evaluation, but the UE never applies the stored conditional RRCReconfiguration of the triggered cell.
queries.rationale: Surface evaluation/execution-condition points at conditional reconfiguration evaluation (38.331#5.3.5.13.4); the answer that the stored condRRCReconfig is applied lives in conditional reconfiguration execution (38.331#5.3.5.13.5).

queries.query: An FR1 measurement gap is configured by gapFR1, yet the MAC entity still sends HARQ feedback, SR, CSI and SRS during the activated gap instead of suspending those transmissions.
queries.rationale: Surface gapFR1/measurement-gap-configuration points at the RRC measurement gap configuration (38.331#5.5.2.9); the run-time rule that MAC suspends HARQ/SR/CSI/SRS during an activated gap is in 38.321#5.14.

queries.query: The physical layer keeps indicating out-of-sync to higher layers past the N310 threshold, but the UE never starts T310 nor declares radio link failure.
queries.rationale: Surface out-of-sync/radio-link-monitoring points at PHY radio link monitoring (38.213#5); the answer that consecutive out-of-sync starts T310 and leads to RLF is RRC RLF detection (38.331#5.3.10.3).

queries.query: The UE computes the Type 1 power headroom value for an activated serving cell but the MAC entity never triggers a power headroom report when the configured PHR conditions are met.
queries.rationale: Surface Type-1-power-headroom computation points at the PHY PH report formula (38.213#7.7.1); the triggering/reporting procedure (phr-PeriodicTimer, prohibit timer, pathloss change) lives in MAC Power Headroom Reporting (38.321#5.4.6).

queries.query: Event A3 fires because a neighbour becomes an offset better than the SpCell, but on receiving the reconfiguration the UE never resets the MAC and applies the new SpCell timing to synchronise to the target.
queries.rationale: Surface event-A3/neighbour-offset points at the A3 measurement event (38.331#5.5.4.4); the answer about MAC reset and synchronising to the target is reconfiguration with sync (38.331#5.3.5.5.2).

queries.query: The serving cell's Srxlev rises well above SIntraSearchP and SIntraSearchQ, yet the UE keeps performing intra-frequency neighbour cell reselection measurements anyway.
queries.rationale: Surface Srxlev/intra-frequency-reselection points at the reselection ranking R-criteria (38.304#5.2.4.6); the answer that the UE may skip intra-frequency measurements when Srxlev/Squal exceed the search thresholds is in measurement rules for cell reselection (38.304#5.2.4.2).

queries.query: The dataInactivityTimer expires while in RRC_CONNECTED but the UE stays in connected mode instead of moving to idle.
queries.rationale: Surface dataInactivityTimer points at MAC data inactivity monitoring (38.321#5.19), which only indicates expiry to upper layers; the actual go-to-RRC_IDLE action is RRC clause 38.331#5.3.8.5.

queries.query: Upper layers indicate SCG deactivation, but the MAC entity does not initialise its buffers, stop its timers and flush HARQ as part of resetting itself.
queries.rationale: Surface SCG-deactivation points at SCG activation/deactivation (38.321#5.29); the normative buffer-init/timer-stop/HARQ-flush behaviour is MAC Reset (38.321#5.12), which deactivation triggers.

queries.query: An LTE RRCConnectionReconfiguration with mobilityControlInfo is received for handover and T304 then expires, but the UE does not revert to the source configuration and re-establish the connection.
queries.rationale: Surface mobilityControlInfo/handover points at the LTE handover-command reception (36.331#5.3.5.4); the failure behaviour on T304 expiry (revert config, initiate re-establishment) is 36.331#5.3.5.6.

queries.query: Consistent LBT failure is detected on the active UL BWP, yet the MAC entity neither triggers a scheduling request on a remaining BWP nor a random access procedure as recovery.
queries.rationale: Surface scheduling-request/random-access point at SR (38.321#5.4.4) and RA initialization; the consistent-LBT-failure recovery rule that selects SR on another BWP or triggers RA lives in LBT failure detection and recovery (38.321#5.21.2).
